name: Nord-Est
summary_text: Nord-Est's distinguishing evidence is Veneto's institutionalised hostility. In 2014 the regional council approved a motion (first signer Councillor Arianna Lazzarini, deliberation no. 92 of 14 October 2014), and the regional government followed with resolution no. 2268 of 27 November 2014 — published in the region's official bulletin (BUR no. 119, 16 December 2014) — instituting an official "Festa della Famiglia Naturale" on the last school day before the Christmas holidays and formally rejecting the aims and content of the WHO Regional Office's *Standards for Sexuality Education in Europe*, committing to counter their adoption in Veneto schools. In July 2018 the council approved motion no. 340 (178th public session, Venice), pledging regional support for "those who fight in defence of the natural family" and natalist policies, attacking Pride events as "carnival farces". Veneto, Venezia (2025): a gay student was stalked by three men who called themselves fascists, reported in the same press coverage that carried the Catania beating. No violence-monitoring data names Veneto, Trentino-Alto Adige or Friuli-Venezia Giulia among the six highest-victim regions. The special-statute regions inside this macro-region (Trentino-Alto Adige, Friuli-Venezia Giulia) have not used expanded legislative competence on gender matters. The natural-family acts and the WHO rejection are official acts of hostility and a clear climate signal to a visitor, but they do not criminalise, fine, or create enforcement exposure; the practical visitor risk from the policy layer is being unwelcome, not arrested.

sources.title: Regione Veneto: Approvata mozione pro "Famiglia Naturale" - Pianeta Milk Arcigay Verona - Lgbt*Center
sources.claim_summary: LGBT association report (July 2018): on 3 July, in the 178th public session of the Veneto regional council in Venice, motion no. 340 (first signer Giovanna Negro) was approved, pledging regional support for "those who fight in defence of the natural family" and for natalist policies, attacking the Cirinnà civil-unions law and dismissing Pride marches as "carnival farces".

sources.title: Dettaglio Deliberazione della Giunta Regionale - Bollettino Ufficiale della Regione del Veneto
sources.claim_summary: Official gazette record of Veneto regional-government resolution no. 2268 of 27 November 2014 (BUR no. 119, 16 December 2014): implementing the regional council's motion (deliberation no. 92 of 14 October 2014), it institutes the "Festa della Famiglia Naturale" on the last school day before the Christmas holidays and rejects the aims and content of the WHO Regional Office's Standards for Sexuality Education in Europe, committing to use every instrument available to counter its adoption in Veneto schools (assessor Elena Donazzan).

sources.title: Catania, aggressione omofoba in un fast food: tre ragazzi gay finiscono in ospedale
sources.claim_summary: LGBT news report (May 2025): three gay men were hospitalised after a homophobic beating by a group at a Catania fast-food restaurant around 5 a.m. on 26 April 2025, with homophobic insults, stools, helmets and blunt objects used, and a pepper-spray intervention ending the attack; the report also recalls the case of a gay student in Venice stalked by three self-described fascist men — "branco"-style mob violence reaching both the north-east and the islands.
